code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
# Edge-by-edge verdict on the seed causal chain, from the 14 recorded findings.
EDGES=[
 ("1. Out-of-frame DMD variant\nabolishes functional dystrophin","Established,\nwith isoform caveat",0.85,
  "gnomAD v4: Dp427m-truncating pLoF\nOR 0.105 (0.069-0.159), p=1.6e-39;\nescapers spare Dp427m or hit exon 71"),
 ("2. Reading-frame rule\n(out-of-frame DMD, in-frame BMD)","Established in registries,\nnot curatable from ClinVar",0.70,
  "ClinVar condition tags: OR 1.57\n(0.47-5.26), p=0.45, N=1,419.\nLOVD/TREAT-NMD not queried"),
 ("3. Dystrophin loss\ndestabilises the DGC","Established\n(post-translational)",0.80,
  "Not testable by transcriptome:\nDGC module median d=-0.06, FDR 0.79,\nonly DMD itself reduced"),
 ("4. DGC loss causes contraction-\ninduced mechanical injury","Established but\nnot the sole route",0.60,
  "Domain-specific deletion test null\nafter correction (all FDR=1.0)"),
 ("5. Calcium influx through\nstretched/damaged membrane","Qualified: channel-\nand ROS-mediated",0.45,
  "TRPV2/TRPC1 mislocalisation,\nmicrotubule-NOX2 X-ROS.\nCYBB d=+1.05 FDR 0.025"),
 ("6. Activation of calcium-\ndependent proteases","Unresolved;\ntranscript sign is opposite",0.25,
  "Protease module FDR 0.42;\nCAPN3 DOWN d=-1.46, FDR 0.003.\nNo activity assay performed"),
 ("7. Repeated cycles build\nfibro-inflammatory pathology","Contradicted as a\ntemporal claim",0.15,
  "Already maximal at 1.5-8 months:\ninflammation d=+4.27, fibrosis d=+2.44;\nno rise in older DMD (all p>0.1)"),
 ("8. Regenerative capacity is\nexhausted by repeated use","Competing: intrinsic\nstem cell defect",0.30,
  "EGF restored mdx strength without\ndystrophin; DMD-Null worse than mdx\nwith equal utrophin"),
 ("9. Fibro-fatty replacement\n-> weakness, cardiac, respiratory","Established\nclinically",0.90,
  "Not re-tested here;\nadipogenic module null in infants\n(d=+0.02, FDR 0.29)"),
 ("10. Dystrophin-restoring therapy\nvalidates the whole chain","Molecularly yes,\nfunctionally unresolved",0.35,
  "EMBARK primary endpoint not met;\nrestoration size does not track\npreserved ambulation (PMID 42510866)"),
]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(14.5,10.2))
cmap=plt.cm.RdYlGn
for i,(edge,verdict,score,eviden) in enumerate(EDGES):
    y=len(EDGES)-i
    ax.barh(y, score, height=.62, color=cmap(score), edgecolor="k", lw=.6)
    ax.text(-0.02, y, edge, ha="right", va="center", fontsize=8.6)
    ax.text(score+0.015, y+0.14, verdict, ha="left", va="center", fontsize=8.3, fontweight="bold")
    ax.text(score+0.015, y-0.19, eviden, ha="left", va="center", fontsize=6.9, color="#333333")
ax.set_xlim(0,1.62); ax.set_ylim(.3,len(EDGES)+.8); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xticks([0,.25,.5,.75,1.0]); ax.set_xticklabels(["refuted","weak","unresolved","partial","established"],fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("evidential standing of the edge after this run", fontsize=10)
ax.set_title("Edge-by-edge verdict on the Canonical Dystrophin Loss and Membrane Fragility Model\n"
             "The two ends of the chain hold. The middle, from calcium entry to cumulative fibro-inflammatory damage, does not.",
             fontsize=11.5, pad=14)
for s in ("top","right","left"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
ax.axvline(1.0, color="grey", lw=.6, ls=":")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("figure rendered;", len(EDGES), "edges scored")
